name: gtsam-points
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: gtsam-points
  version: "1.2.2"
  build_number: 1

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/koide3/gtsam_points/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: e9c629d140eb5c30437ccdd18d853223db64dd60c3a4a81c452e763857fbc7c5
    patches:
      - 001-unvendor-nanoflann.patch
      # Fix segfault in align_points_4dof with Eigen 5 (invalid runtime
      # arguments passed to the fixed-size topLeftCorner<2, 2> accessor).
      - 002-fix-eigen5-4dof-alignment.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  skip: not linux
  # Explicit build string suffix to easily differentiate CPU and CUDA builds.
  string: ${{ "cpu" if cuda_compiler_version == "None" else "cuda" + (cuda_compiler_version | replace('.', '')) }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  # Native rattler-build support for prioritizing CUDA over CPU builds.
  # The CPU variant receives a penalty (1), allowing the solver to prefer CUDA (0).
  # This works in combination with the __cuda virtual package constraint in the run requirements.
  variant:
    use_keys:
      - cuda_compiler_version
    down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 1 if cuda_compiler_version == "None" else 0 }}

outputs:
  # =====================
  # Package: gtsam-points
  # =====================
  - package:
      name: gtsam-points
    build:
      script:
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - test -n "$CUDAARCHS"
            - echo $CUDAARCHS
        - cmake -S . -B build -GNinja
          ${{ "${CMAKE_ARGS}" if not win else "%CMAKE_ARGS%" }}
          -DBUILD_DEMO=OFF
          -DBUILD_TOOLS=OFF
          -DBUILD_TESTS=OFF
          -DBUILD_EXAMPLE=OFF
          -DBUILD_WITH_TBB=ON
          -DBUILD_WITH_MARCH_NATIVE=OFF
          -DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS="-Wno-deprecated-gpu-targets"
          -DBUILD_WITH_CUDA=${{ "ON" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "OFF" }}
          -DGTSAM_POINTS_USE_CUDA=${{ "ON" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "OFF" }}
          -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES="${CUDAARCHS-}"
        - cmake --build build/ --config Release
        - cmake --install build/ --config Release
        # Build tests always, but run them only on native CPU build.
        - cmake -S . -B build -DBUILD_TESTS=ON -DCMAKE_GTEST_DISCOVER_TESTS_DISCOVERY_MODE=PRE_TEST
        - cmake --build build/
        - if: build_platform == target_platform and cuda_compiler_version == "None"
          then:
            - ctest --test-dir build/ --rerun-failed --output-on-failure
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
      host:
        - gtsam
        - eigen-abi-devel
        - libboost-devel
        - nanoflann
        - tbb-devel
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
            - cuda-cudart-dev
            - libcublas-dev
            - libcurand-dev
            - libcusparse-dev
            - libcusolver-dev
      run:
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            # The __cuda virtual package acts as a hardware lock.
            # It prevents the solver from picking the prioritized CUDA build on a CPU-only machine,
            # forcing a graceful fallback to the CPU build.
            - __cuda
        # Override the run exports of gtsam alpha.
        # We want the gtsam-points build to be compatible only with other dev gtsam version, not stable ones.
        - if: match(gtsam, ">=4.3deva1,<4.3.0")
          then:
            - gtsam >=4.3deva1,<4.3.0
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - if: match(gtsam, ">=4.3deva1,<4.3.0")
            then:
              - gtsam
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - gtsam_points/config.hpp
          lib:
            - gtsam_points
            - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
              then: gtsam_points_cuda
  # ===========================
  # Package: gtsam-points-devel
  # ===========================
  - package:
      name: gtsam-points-devel
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('gtsam-points', exact=True) }}
        - eigen
        - eigen-abi-devel
        - libboost-devel
        - nanoflann
        - tbb-devel
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - cuda-cudart-dev
            - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('gtsam-points', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - cmake-package-check gtsam_points --targets gtsam_points
        requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - cmake
            - cmake-package-check
            - ninja
            - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
              then: ${{ compiler('cuda') }}

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/koide3/gtsam_points
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/koide3/gtsam_points
  summary: A collection of GTSAM factors and optimizers for point cloud SLAM.

extra:
  feedstock-name: gtsam-points
  recipe-maintainers:
    - diegoferigo
